technical.summary: Mixed bullish technicals (RSI14, Supertrend, Ichimoku) offset by weak trend strength, stochastic oversold conditions, and price positioning below key moving averages; moderate confluence but lacks conviction for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 28 days adds timing risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: Fear-driven market presents contrarian opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal (junior member, small amounts) with no composite signal, and absent news data limits conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (315.2) indicates extreme market stress, with earnings event in 28 days adding binary risk to ACN position.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI14 bullish, Supertrend bullish, and Ichimoku above cloud provide technical confluence in a fear-driven market near support (286.73), offering contrarian entry opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely unfavourable (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels), fundamental support is absent (no insider/institutional conviction, earnings risk in 28 days), and price remains below key moving averages (SMA21, Hull MA, 200EMA) with weak trend strength (ADX 23.83).

decision.entry_rationale: Technical confluence (RSI14, Supertrend, Ichimoku) offers contrarian setup at support in fear-driven market. However, macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis), absent fundamental conviction, and earnings binary risk in 28 days do not justify entry.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve and VIX crisis levels signal severe macro stress; earnings event in 28 days creates binary downside risk with no institutional or insider support to cushion volatility.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Existing ACN position plus 3 other IT holdings in 24-position portfolio creates sector concentration; skip reduces redundancy and preserves capital in hostile macro environment.
